jobs.title: Software Engineer - 175793
jobs.description:
Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking an experienced Software Engineer
to support a leading aerospace and defense organization delivering advanced command-and-control capabilities for a mission-critical U.S. government defense program. This role is fully onsite in Colorado Springs, CO (NO FLEXIBILITY) and requires an active Top Secret clearance w/ SCI eligibility*

The Software Engineer
will lead the design, development, integration, and sustainment of mission-critical software supporting space systems, ground segments, Command & Control (C2), mission planning, and real-time data processing
. This role will drive full-lifecycle software development across API/backend architecture, front-end and geospatial applications, and Agile/DevSecOps environments
, while providing technical leadership and ensuring solutions meet performance, security, quality, and customer requirements.

Responsibilities of the Software Enginee
r:

Lead full-lifecycle development of mission-critical software supporting space systems, ground segments, C2, mission planning, and real-time data processing, from requirements and architecture through deployment and sustainment.
Architect and develop high-performance APIs, backend services, and system integrations connecting front-end and backend applications, with an emphasis on automation, security, reliability, and performance.
Lead Agile/DevSecOps development and integration utilizing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, builds, and deployment workflows.
Develop modern, intuitive front-end applications and real-time 2D/3D geospatial visualizations, translating UI/UX designs into functional software.
Lead code reviews, troubleshooting, testing, and performance optimization while driving software quality, security, development standards, and process improvements.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship across engineering teams, including R&D efforts, emerging technology implementation, and software/supplier performance.

Qualifications for the
Software Engineer:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of software development supporting space/ground systems, including C2, mission planning, and real-time data processing.
5+ years of Python and 3+ years of JavaScript (Angular/JQuery), TypeScript, Java, and FastAPI development.
5+ years of full SDLC experience, including requirements, design, development, integration, testing, and deployment.
5+ years developing real-time 2D/3D geospatial UIs and working with PostgreSQL and SQL/NoSQL databases.
5+ years of software leadership on government programs, including Agile/DevSecOps environments and technical mentorship.
Experience with API/backend architecture, CI/CD, automated testing/builds/deployments, and secure software development.
Strong knowledge of C2, mission planning, ground systems, and mission-critical real-time applications; ability to obtain required program suitability.
Active Top Secret (w/ SCI eligibility) or active TS/SCI clearance*
IAT Level II certification (Sec+, CCNA, CySA+, etc...)
Ability & Willingness to work fully onsite in Colorado Springs, CO.

Compensation for the
Software Engineer:

Salary Range: $170,000 - $210,000 *depending on experience*
Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k Plan, PTO, Holidays, Sick Leave if required by law

This job opens for applications on 09/21. Applications for this job will be accepted for at least 30 days from the posting date.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company

Switchboard is rebuilding the commercial insurance brokerage from the ground up to help America’s small businesses get to work and keep working.
Insurance is 14% of the American economy, and businesses alone spend $500B on premiums every year. For the men and women who run America's small businesses, insurance isn't optional. No restaurant owner can sign a lease, no contractor can start a new job, no local manufacturer can start a new production line without it.
But only 15% of small business insurance gets placed directly online.
The other 85% goes through a local broker who doesn’t specialize in complex SMB insurance - so they quote one or two markets, do the minimum, and walk away when the work gets hard. Businesses end up overpaying, get the wrong coverage, or go uninsured entirely.
We're building the full brokerage digital stack end to end, with humans and AI agents working together, so a small business owner gets the same quality of advice, service, and choice a billion-dollar company gets.
We’re a small team with the goal of building a generational financial services company that becomes the permanent foundation of how the small-business economy works.
If solving hard technical problems from first principles, operating at the frontier of what AI can actually do in a real, regulated, money-moving industry excites you, come join us.

About the role

You'll ship production code from your first week; not toy features, but real systems. You'll have access to mentorship by senior engineers and will learn more in three months here than three years at a big company. We're looking for someone who wants to become a great engineer by doing, not by waiting for permission.
You will work directly with the co-founders, CTO Huy Huynh & CEO Matthew Levin plus another senior engineer.

Responsibilities

Build and ship features end to end with AI agents
Contribute to the full-stack (backend, frontend, infrastructure, deployment). We ship features from concept to production in days not weeks. Our tech stack includes: Ruby on Rails 8.1, Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus), Postgres, and AWS, but experience with Rails is not required
Write production-grade code with tests, handle edge cases, and own what you ship
Pair with senior engineers and founders, learning by doing

Requirements

You've built and shipped something real whether that’s a side project, an open-source tool, etc. We care about what you've done, not where you went to school
Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, systems design, ability to reason about how things work under the hood. Formal CS education is not required but first principles knowledge is.
You use AI tools to write code and are intentional about how you work
Effective cross-disciplinary communicator
Nice to have: familiarity with any OOP language, open-source contributions or publicly visible work

Benefits

$80k-110k/yr base + equity
20 days PTO
Medical, dental, vision
401k
Paid parental leave

This is an on site in our office at 221 Canal St, NYC. If you want to build the financial infrastructure that America's small businesses run on, please apply.

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Meds.com is a rapidly growing consumer technology firm operating a suite of healthcare businesses, including our flagship brand BlueChew. Our mission is to better patients' lives through innovative healthcare solutions. With a team of 350 professionals across various specialties, we've built scalable pharmacy, telemedicine, and e-commerce platforms using cutting-edge technology. As we continue our accelerated growth trajectory, we're launching new products to expand our patient base and accelerate growth. Join us in tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of healthcare and technology.

At BlueChew, "Fullstack" means more than just connecting a database to a UI. You will be building the digital bridge between a patient's medical consultation and the physical delivery of their prescription. This role is for an engineer who thrives on the "hard problems" of healthcare - maintaining strict HIPAA - compliant security and high-availability systems while delivering the sleek, intuitive user experience of a modern D2C brand.

Join our team in Austin, TX or Chicago, IL - we are looking for someone who truly values and enjoys working in the office, not just tolerates it.

Responsibilities

Architect and build key features for major business areas such as pharmacy operations, ecommerce, and telemedicine.
Produce high quality code for peer review
Provide technical guidance for junior engineers
Code review for peers

Technology Utilization

Main programming languages: TypeScript, Python, Ruby
Databases: SQL and no-SQL, BigQuery, MongoDB
Frameworks, key libraries, and runtime: Angular, Node JS, AWS Chime, FreeSwitch
Infrastructure: Google Cloud, AWS, GitHub, and on-premise servers
Project management: Azure DevOps

Notable Projects & Accomplishments

Telemedicine Platform: Proprietary system with EHR (electronic health records) integration, web-based video calls, and SIP-to-web voice conversion
Pharmacy Software: Scalable system handling high-volume prescription fulfillment
E-commerce Engine: Includes integrated shipping, payments, email, and more

Qualifications

Education & Experience
BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Math, Science, Engineering, Economics, or other highly quantitative disciplines, or equivalent experience.
Solid grasp of computer science foundations, mainly algorithms and data structures
Expertise in one or more modern programming languages. Examples are TypeScript, Javascript, Python, Go, C++, Java, etc

Ideal Profile

Has written lots of non-trivial code
Has had to design creative engineering solutions frequently
A problem solver with a sound computer science background.
Enjoys coming up with a new code architecture, studying a new open-source library, building a new internal library, and designing the detailed steps to implement a big feature
Ability to learn quickly how a standard computer science algorithm works, such as graph algorithms, sorting algorithms, etc.
Should possess real expertise in at least one programming language.
BS, MS, PhD in Computer Science, Math, Science, Engineering, Economics, or other highly quantitative disciplines, or equivalent experience
Strong understanding of core computer science principles, including algorithms and data structures
Proficiency in at least one or more modern programming language such as TypeScript, Python, Go, JavaScript, C++, or Java

Highlights

Competitive Pay
Work on the ground floor launching new DTC medications
Be on the cutting edge of both telemedicine and software engineering
Contribute as a core team member of the SWE team

Interview Process

15 minute HR Screening
1 hour take home test with a sequence of algorithm challenges screen recorded, first 30 min without AI help, and 30 min with optional AI help
1 hour live technical interview with a team member focused on algorithms
Additional technical interview with a team member focused on algorithms (1 hour)
Final round: on-site visit to our Austin office or video interview with CEO, CTO, and other senior members of the team

Perks

100% company-paid Medical, Dental, Vision premium coverage,plus Short-Term Disability and Life Insurance.
401K with company match.
Paid time off and company-paid holidays
Enjoy free daily lunch

We are looking for top-talent that wants to make a measurable impact in an exciting, fast-paced environment. This role is full-time in Elmhurst, IL.
